name: How the web service reads a request body (whole and bounded, or streamed for one route)
summary: Before a route runs, ApiHandler._read_request reads its body whole with _read_body: at most max_body (MAX_BODY_BYTES, 256 KiB; 413 beyond), under the slow-client watch, JSON only. A route registered with route(..., stream=True) (STREAMED: the task-file upload only) skips that read and streams its own body in 64 KiB steps; its answer always closes the connection.
